rules.description: Security Sentinel violation detected or prohibited privilege escalation requested.
rules.consequence: Execution halted immediately; mission state transitions to BLOCKED.

rules.description: Mission involves financial transaction or resource purchase exceeding autonomous limit.
rules.consequence: Halt for mandatory operator authorization before funds commitment.

rules.description: Repetitive state, cyclical replanning, or repeated repair oscillation detected.
rules.consequence: Escalate to operator to break cyclic deadlock; autonomous loop suspended.

rules.description: Mission requirements or scope diverged unexpectedly from original user directive without formal intent delta.
rules.consequence: Escalate to operator for confirmation of scope realignment.

rules.description: Adaptations, repairs, or replans exceeded configured AdaptationBudget limits.
rules.consequence: Escalate to operator to avoid infinite resource consumption.

rules.description: Consecutive execution or validation failures exceeded threshold.
rules.consequence: Halt autonomous attempts and request manual guidance.

rules.description: All requirements satisfied, execution succeeded, evidence complete, validation passed, zero false success confirmed.
rules.consequence: Mission concludes successfully with verifiable proof ledger.

rules.description: Pending human gate confirmation requested by policy, high risk score, or explicit directive.
rules.consequence: Wait for operator input; loop enters WAITING_HUMAN stage.

rules.description: Task or validation failure occurred with AST/runtime diagnosis and repair budget available.
rules.consequence: Trigger self-healing repair pipeline without declaring premature success.

rules.description: Task failure occurred without viable automated patch diagnosis.
rules.consequence: Escalate to operator with diagnostics and failure logs.

rules.description: Task dependency invalidated, new structural dependency discovered, or plan DAG broken.
rules.consequence: Trigger dynamic replanning to compute plan delta preserving completed work.

rules.description: Observed outcome deviated from prediction, but mission requirements remain satisfiable via localized adaptation.
rules.consequence: Formulate and apply AdaptationProposal (e.g. add validation, adjust task priority).

rules.description: Assigned task owner agent is offline/unresponsive, and another capable swarm agent is available.
rules.consequence: Reassign task ownership to standby agent and update DAG routing.

rules.description: Observed state matches expectations, validations pass, requirements progressing steadily.
rules.consequence: Advance to next cycle and continue DAG execution.

changelog: Phase 40 baseline deterministic decision policy (14 rules).
Proposal prop_c_oscillation_defense_1_37623: Guarantees oscillation history recorded in previous cycle is evaluated before deciding next step, eliminating observation gap in Decision #191.
